content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Municipal street sweepers, vacuum trucks and sirens for public agencies; no railcar manufacturing, leasing or crash-barrier business."},{"label":"C2","good":true,"reason":"Manufactures and repairs railcars for lessors, railroads and shippers, matching Trinity's railcar manufacturing and maintenance business."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Industrial drums, containers and paperboard packaging plus timberland; no railcar or highway safety products."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Pumps, valves and friction components for industrial markets; rail appears only as a minor brake-component customer."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Trucking and intermodal freight services that move shippers' goods; Trinity makes and leases railcars rather than providing transport."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Track components, rail services and precast concrete for railroads; shares rail customers but not railcar manufacturing or leasing."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Core business is irrigation equipment for farmers; its highway guardrail and crash cushions overlap only one segment of Trinity."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Oil refining and fuel retail and logistics; no railcar, rail equipment or highway safety products."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Engines and generator sets sold to equipment makers; no railcar, rail or highway safety business."}]}
